subject: Vendor onboarding: Multipass Retail PO schema, VAT and remit setup
messages:
From: Katerina Novak <katerina.novak@multipassretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Multipass Retail

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well — I’m the procurement lead for Payments at Multipass Retail. We’re getting Redwood set up as an approved supplier in our AP system so we can start routing POs and payments. To get the vendor record created we need: 

- Company legal name and remit-to banking (IBAN + SWIFT for EU wires)
- VAT registration number (EU) or equivalent tax ID
- Registered address for billing and the address to appear on invoices
- A sample invoice and our PO schema (fields we require on every invoice)
- A completed vendor questionnaire (attached)

Can you provide an AP onboarding packet and a contact for finance to confirm bank details securely? Also, are you able to accept consolidated monthly invoices or do you require per-PO invoicing? Our preferred flow is per-PO but we can accommodate monthly statements where agreed.

Attaching our vendor questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,
Katerina Novak
Procurement Lead — Payments
Multipass Retail
(Attachment: Vendor_Questionnaire_Multipass.pdf (pdf))

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Katerina Novak <katerina.novak@multipassretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Multipass Retail

Katerina — thanks for the quick note and the questionnaire. Welcome — excited to get Multipass set up.

I attached our AP onboarding packet which contains: company legal details, Redwood Inference VAT/EUID (EU branch), sample invoice header, bank instructions (IBAN + BIC), and our invoice submission preferences. Quick callouts:

- PO fields we require from customers for automated matching: PO number, PO line item ids (if present), bill-to entity code, and the invoice reference that matches the PO. Missing the PO number will delay matching and payment.
- Invoices must display Redwood’s legal billing address and VAT ID exactly as in the packet.
- We can accept monthly consolidated invoices for managed services, but for pay-as-you-go hosted usage we prefer per-PO/per-month line items to keep reconciliation clean. Happy to map to your preferred flow if you confirm which path you want.
- For bank verification, please use our secure vendor verification link (I included it below) — finance requires that bank details are confirmed over our portal before EFT is enabled.

I’ve cc’d Laura from Ops who handles invoice formatting and feed mapping; Laura, could you confirm if the sample_invoice_header.csv covers Multipass’s schema? Vivek, I’ll loop you once we have final bank details to ask finance to create the vendor record.

Attachments: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
https://secure.redwood.com/payments/vendor-verify/DEAL-8342

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Multipass Retail

Rachel / Vivek — reviewed Katerina’s questionnaire and Redwood’s packet. A few technical notes for AP ingestion and billing automation: 

- Sample invoice header attached (sample_invoice_header.csv) — it includes fields we generate automatically: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, po_line_ref, service_period_start/end, token_usage_summary (for hosted usage), unit_price_usd, tax_amount, total_due.
- Multipass’s PO schema will need to include a bill-to entity code and ship-to code if they want separate legal entities. Without entity codes we map to the primary bill-to entity and manual reconciliation may be required.
- For EU VAT: include the customer VAT ID on the PO and the invoice where reverse-charge applies. If Multipass expects us to apply VAT at invoicing time, they must supply their VAT ID and confirm tax treatment per line item.
- We can accept invoices as PDF or structured EDI/XML upload — for automated ingestion prefer CSV or UBL/Peppol where available.

Next steps I recommend: 1) Ask Multipass to send their PO spec (schema) and example PO exports, 2) Confirm EFT vs SEPA preference and provide an account verification task via our secure portal, 3) Decide on per-PO vs consolidated monthly billing for the first 90 days.

(Attachment: sample_invoice_header.csv (csv))

Laura Bennett
Billing & Integrations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Katerina Novak <katerina.novak@multipassretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T08:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Multipass Retail

Thanks Rachel and Laura — attaching our PO spec and an example PO export. A few clarifications: 

- Attachment: MP_PO_Spec_v3.xlsx (xlsx) — required fields: PO Number, PO Date, Buyer Entity Code, Ship-to Entity Code, Currency, Line Unit Price, Tax Code per line, and GL Account (optional).
- We can include the buyer VAT ID on the PO when billing is cross-border; where reverse-charge applies we expect the supplier to invoice net and reference the reverse-charge clause.
- For payment methods: Preference is SEPA where the vendor supports IBAN. If vendor cannot SEPA, we’ll default to international wire (SWIFT).
- Regarding consolidated invoices: Multipass prefers per-PO matching for the first 6 months while we reconcile volumes. After that we may move to consolidated monthly statements by agreement.

Let me know once you’ve completed the secure bank verification so we can enable EFT payments.

Best,
Katerina Novak
Procurement Lead — Payments
Multipass Retail
(Attachment: MP_PO_Spec_v3.xlsx (xlsx))
